name: constructor-mcp
description: Curate and balance-check metabolic reactions via the Constructor API (VMH ecosystem).
long_description: Resolve metabolites (VMH, ChEBI, PubChem, SwissLipids, SMILES), create reactions and get mass/charge balance verdicts, import reactions from VMH and Rhea, and manage your saved reactions — conversationally. Talks only HTTP to a Constructor instance; it can never write to the shared VMH database.

base_url.title: Constructor URL
base_url.description: Base URL of the Constructor instance you use.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Your personal Constructor API key (ctor_...). Sign in to Constructor and generate it at <Constructor URL>/api-key/ — it is shown only once.
